document-intelligence-commitment-tier.title: A commitment tier would cost less than pay-as-you-go here
document-intelligence-commitment-tier.body: At the page volume in this estimate, the monthly price of a Document Intelligence commitment tier (plus any overage) is lower than paying per page. Microsoft offers commitment tiers as discounted rates compared to the standard pricing model; the commitment is a fixed monthly fee, so use it only for steady volume.

citation.quote: Foundry Tools offers commitment tier pricing, allowing discounted rates compared to the Standard pricing model.

document-intelligence-commitment-single-.title: Commitment tiers need a dedicated Document Intelligence resource
document-intelligence-commitment-single-.body: This estimate uses a commitment plan. Microsoft states commitment tier pricing cannot be used with a multi-service resource, so the commitment has to be bought against a dedicated Document Intelligence resource.

citation.quote: You cannot use commitment tier pricing with a Foundry Tools or a Microsoft Foundry multi-service resource.
